collectible:4.text: Ellie's journal is an artifact that is found during the "Jackson" chapter in The Last of Us Part II. It is an old journal owned by Ellie. Here she draws and writes her thoughts throughout the game. Ellie's journal can be found in her house on a desk close to her jacket. It is automatically picked up when she leaves to go on patrol with Dina.

collectible:5.text: Safes are item caches that can be found in the The Last of Us and The Last of Us Part II. They contain supplies abandoned by people during the initial outbreak or stashed during later conflicts. They require a combination to open, which can be found on certain Artifacts or in the environment. Safes can hold ammo, crafting supplies, parts, and even Training Manuals.

collectible:6.text: A workbench is used in The Last of Us and in The Last of Us Part II to upgrade firearms to make them more powerful. To upgrade them, parts are needed, as well as tools upgrades in the first game. As Joel acquires weapons, tools, and parts, he can use them to make his weapons more powerful, such as faster reloading and adding a second gun holsters.

easter-egg:1.text: The antique ring found in Ellie's Seattle Day 1 chapter is Francis Drake's ring from the Uncharted series.

easter-egg:2.text: The strange relic found by Abby in her Seattle Day 1 chapter is a reference to the Precursor orb from the Jak and Daxter series. The Precursor orb also appears as an artifact of the same name in the Uncharted series.

easter-egg:3.text: Photos of Naughty Dog staff members' pets are seen in the game, such as sound implementer Christopher Walasek's cat appearing on "missing cat" posters around Seattle, and game designer Pete Ellis's cat Reginald, who appears on a calendar in Ellie's Seattle Day 2 chapter.
